subject.title: Feature request: Per-channel tool call budget with auto-delegation

question: Should OpenClaw add core scoped tool-call budgets, and what precedence plus child-session authority should automatic channel overflow delegation use?
rationale: Source inspection proves the capability is missing, but the requested config and auto-spawn behavior add public config, channel policy, session-state, and security semantics that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Design scoped warn/block first
options.body: Add a generic default-off budget model with clear precedence and deterministic warn/block behavior before separately considering automatic subagent overflow.

options.title: Sponsor full auto-delegation
options.body: Approve a broader project covering channel overflow spawning, inherited authority, completion routing, upgrade behavior, and security proof together.

options.title: Keep as guidance only
options.body: Decline core enforcement for now and document prompt/tool-policy patterns for operators who want manual delegation.

recommendation.title: Design scoped warn/block first
recommendation.body: Add a generic default-off budget model with clear precedence and deterministic warn/block behavior before separately considering automatic subagent overflow.

likelyOwner.reason: He already provided the issue's maintainer-facing design review and appears in adjacent subagent and routing history.
